sources.title: Directive 2002/58/EC concerning privacy and electronic communications
sources.notes: Primary EU ePrivacy Directive. National transposition and applicable Member State law must be considered.

sources.title: Directive 2009/136/EC amending Directive 2002/58/EC
sources.notes: Amendment containing the current Article 5(3) wording. Registered during the Phase 6C conversion because the ePrivacy research already names it as a primary source (regimes/eu-eprivacy.md 2.1, 18, 23) but the register did not carry it, so Article 5(3) requirements could not cite the instrument that produced the wording they restate. Member-State transposition deadline 25 May 2011. No retrieved_date: the entry records a reference the research already made and the document was not re-retrieved during conversion.

sources.title: Resolução nº 32, de 26 de janeiro de 2026 — EU Adequacy Recognition
sources.authority: Autoridade Nacional de Proteção de Dados
sources.notes: Recognizes the European Union and specified EEA countries/institutions as providing an adequate level of protection for LGPD international-transfer purposes, subject to the resolution's scope and exceptions.
